channel.title: Laser Focus World - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Laser Focus World (laserfocusworld.com)

item.title: Appotronics' Optical Engines: Empowering AR Glasses Makers
item.description: Chen Menghao, General Manager of the Appotronics Innovation Center, introduces pioneering miniature optical engines for AR glasses: the Dragonfly G1 Mini, the Dragonfly C1, and a laser+LCOS prototype. These enable compact, cost-effective green or full-color binocular displays, helping to overcome key industry roadblocks.

item.title: Cross-layer all-optical physiology permits neuron circuit mapping
item.description: Cross-layer all-optical physiology provides an essential tool for directly probing functional connectivity and causal interactions within neuronal circuits—and achieves high-speed, cross-layer two-photon imaging and optogenetics.

item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 13, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A terahertz wave-based method shows promise for wireless comms, this week's photonics news roundup, and optical frequency combs could enhance radio telescopes.

item.title: Spark Photonics Foundation expands reach of its educational programs
item.description: With a grant from Intel Corp., the Spark Photonics Foundation expands in Arizona, New Mexico, Ohio, and Oregon to ‘spark’ educators’ and K-14 students’ interest in learning about photonics, semiconductors, and manufacturing.

item.title: Imec expands opportunities for photonic integrated circuits and copackaged optics
item.description: In a quick Q&A, imec’s Leili Shiramin shares ways the organization eases the journey into photonic integrated circuit design and copackaged optics.

item.title: The end of electronic compute: AI needs new physics
item.description: Artificial intelligence comes at a cost in terms of energy, economics, and environmental impact. To sustain it, we need to rethink the physics of modern computing via photonics.

item.title: A solution to the laser source bottleneck for DWDM copackaged optics?
item.description: Scintil Photonics and Tower Semiconductor produce the world’s first heterogeneously integrated photonics dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) laser sources—moving DWDM beyond a lab curiosity to a commercial product that can be manufactured at scale today on the same lines as tens of millions of pluggable optical transceivers.

item.title: PODCAST: Interview with Patrick Heissler, CEO of SCRONA
item.description: Episode 90 of Following the Photons: A Photonics Podcast features Dr. Patrick Heissler, CEO of SCRONA, a microfabrication technology provider.

item.title: What if optical cavities stop resonating?
item.description: A novel Fabry-Pérot cavity incorporating a holographic phase mask demonstrates resonance-free operation by driving an unrestricted orbital-angular-momentum ladder-up process, which enables broadband transmission from a high-Q cavity.

item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 20, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A highly sensitive biosensor detects trace cancer biomarkers, this week's photonics business news roundup, and an ultrafast switching mirror device has use as an optical transistor.
